name: MatterGen
one_liner: A joint 3D diffusion model generates atom types, coordinates and periodic lattices conditioned on target properties, and Density Functional Theory relaxations verify stability and property values.

loop.proposes: 3D periodic crystal structures (atom species, fractional coordinates and lattice vectors) sampled by an equivariant diffusion model with property adapter modules
loop.judged_by: Machine-learned interatomic potential pre-screening followed by Density Functional Theory (DFT) structural relaxation, convex-hull stability and property calculation
loop.steers: Adapters are fine-tuned on a labelled dataset; generated candidates are pre-relaxed with MatterSim and checked with DFT afterwards.

headline_result: In Nature (2025), MatterGen more than doubled the fraction of generated inorganic structures that are both novel and thermodynamically stable (within 0.1 eV/atom of the DFT convex hull) compared with prior generative baselines, and reduced root-mean-square atomic displacement during DFT relaxation by more than 50%. In a targeted high-bulk-modulus search, the authors synthesized a generated compound (TaCr2O6) in the lab whose measured bulk modulus (169 GPa) matched the target within 20%.
caveat: Stability and property rates are primarily evaluated in 0 K DFT simulations rather than wet-lab synthesis; only one candidate structure (TaCr2O6, which turned out to be a disordered solid solution in experiment) was synthesized in the paper.
beyond_harness_note: An equivariant 3D diffusion model generates crystals directly in continuous and discrete symmetry spaces, and DFT physics calculations check generated candidates afterwards, while the adapters are fine-tuned on a labelled dataset.
generative_model: Equivariant score-based diffusion model over atom types, coordinates and periodic lattices with fine-tuned adapter modules (not an LLM)
algorithmic_authority: MatterSim pre-relaxation and Density Functional Theory (DFT) convex-hull and property evaluation, plus X-ray diffraction and nanoindentation on the synthesized sample

sources.title: A generative model for inorganic materials design (Nature, 2025)

verification.notes: Verified against Zeni, Pinsler, Zügner et al., Nature 639, 624-632 (2025), doi:10.1038/s41586-025-08628-5, and microsoft/mattergen. Confirmed >2x novel+stable rate, >50% lower RMSD to DFT local minimum, and experimental synthesis of TaCr2O6 (measured bulk modulus 169 GPa, within 20% of 200 GPa target).
